description: Themes in {protein, lipid, nucleic acid, carbohydrate, amino acid, membrane} are ubiquitous and penalized
Nodes in {stretch, stretching, vibration, breathing, deformation, ring} are structurally generic

Specificity floor of 0.1 prevents zero-specificity themes from scoring zero
Geometric mean ensures both support AND specificity needed for high rank
